scope: One canonical identity/field atom: kind0 omitted,1 explicit absence,2 null,3 known canonical value. Correct typed key grouping, normalization, unique map entries and complete traversal are premises. Symmetric equal atoms do not change classification despite distinct source carriers. A modeled changed policy-used ownership atom needs owner and policy grants on both states. This is not proof of whole-inventory/index implementation, TypeScript refinement, core normalization, budgets/heap/CPU, native facts/effects/transactions, host binding authentication or backend admission.
